author: 0x4272616E646F6E
description: Human-like Discord interactions powered by an LLM. Point it at any OpenAI-compatible endpoint - typically a local server you host yourself (Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM, LM Studio, ...). No provider-specific configuration.
install_msg: Point the cog at your LLM endpoint with `[p]aiagentowner endpoint <URL>` (default: http://localhost:11434/v1), pick a model with `[p]aiagent model list`, then whitelist a channel with `[p]aiagent add #channel`. See the cog README for the rest.
short: Human-like user behavior powered by a local LLM.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores the Discord user IDs of users who have opted in or out of having their messages processed, plus any per-user prompt overrides a server admin sets. Message content is not stored persistently; recent channel messages are read at response time and sent to the LLM endpoint the bot owner has configured.
